title: Add photos to JobCam and show them to your client

steps.caption: JobCam
steps.narration: Add photos you already have to a job, then show them to your client.

steps.caption: Which job?
steps.narration: First, the job the photos belong to. Search for it.

steps.caption: Add photos from your library
steps.narration: This button adds photos from your computer or camera roll.

steps.caption: Uploading in the background
steps.narration: They upload in the background, so you can keep working.

steps.caption: Open the job's photos
steps.narration: Choose the last photo to open the job.

steps.caption: Filed to the job
steps.narration: Here they are, filed to the job. So far, only your team can see them.

steps.caption: Select
steps.narration: To share some with your client, choose Select.

steps.caption: Tick a photo
steps.narration: Tick the photos they should see.

steps.caption: The client's portal
steps.narration: Now your client. They sign in to their portal with a link sent to their email.

steps.caption: The shared photos
steps.narration: And there are the two photos you shared. The third one stays with your team.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Back in your CRM, you can hide a photo again the same way.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: JobCam is in the left menu.

youtube.title: How to add job photos and share them with a client | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Add photos from your computer or camera roll to a job in ConstructHUB JobCam, choose which ones your client may see, and look at them in the client portal. Recorded in a demo workspace; the pictures are drawings made for the demo.
